analysis_conventions.agreement: Root confirmed these conventions before inspecting candidate outcomes.
analysis_conventions.experimental_unit: channel; eight channels receive equal weight
analysis_conventions.failed_methods: Gate remains false. Preserve finite recorded gate-component/physical diagnostics; replace only undefined secondary metrics by conservative sentinels.
analysis_conventions.metric_source: Archived gate.metric_values: process fidelity, full-design RMSE, normalized TP. Penalized objectives and timing never enter ranking.
analysis_conventions.missing_metrics: Undefined/nonfinite fidelity ranks as0; undefined/nonfinite full-design RMSE or normalized TP ranks as positive infinity. No outcome is omitted. Null with ranking_sentinel='+infinity' encodes the latter in JSON.
order: highest nested mean gate components passed
analysis_conventions.scores: Gate and gate-component scores: nested means across sampling, initialization, channel. Physical tie breakers: median across eight channel means after the same within-channel nesting.
analysis_conventions.within_channel: Mean sampling streams within initialization, then mean initializations; this plan has one initialization. Printed deterministic copies are counted once.
